$comment: The proof kit this leg runs: one release asset of https://github.com/Fuaran-Core/fuaran-core, pinned by sha256. proofs/check.ps1 downloads it (or takes the local file -KitAsset names, for an offline run), refuses any other bytes, and runs the engine, the prover pin and the read-only models from it. Moving to a newer kit is changing these four values together, then a cold run of the leg; the kit's release notes say what a kit change asks of an adopter.
